note: A document whose created carries a non-Z offset (spec 4.3 names created, started and ended as the record-level timestamps, all under one grammar). diagnose/timestamp-with-offset.vnx pins the rule on a track's started only, so a reader that checks track stamps and reads the document header as a plain string passes every other case. The value is dropped and diagnosed, never refused, for the same reason as a track's: section 6.2's rule for an unusable value is drop-and-diagnose, and refusing a whole library over its export date would be disproportionate. The top-level point's count and position show the document survived the diagnostic: a reader that refused, or that dropped the document along with the stamp, fails them.

diagnostics.message_advisory: must be UTC with a Z suffix
